featured_reviews.review_text: I can rate that Good Food Concept - Catering services are the best in Mumbai. For few years now, my wife and I enjoy the catering at Hinduja hospital (health check) as both the meals are very delicious, well displayed and arranged. The staff are really of the highest standards - keep up the great art.

featured_reviews.name: Anish Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: Very poor experience. Amit from their team did a really poor job coordinating the whole thing. Would not recommend. Clarification - I ordered in 2024 and I was late to post a review. Something Mr. Amit called me regarding and highlighted I should mention here. No remorse or discussion about the feedback but just that I should mention that the review is for an order from 2024.

featured_reviews.name: Rima Adya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a really bad experience with their oriental cuisine. The food was highly sub standard in quality, instructions were not adhered to inspite of repeated reminders. The service provided was very unprofessional, from arriving late to soiled platters etc., and bad packaging, all in all a total mess. For the price we paid it was a total rip off. Any street food would have been far better. Will not be ever using the services of GFC again. And the less said about the manager Amit the better. Total apathy and disinterest in his job.
A special mention for the server Ashok who was very helpful and well mannered, the only redeeming feature of our whole experience!

featured_reviews.name: Tarang Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a very poor experience - the catering crew showed up 15 mins before the event started! All our food service was delayed, and some of the dishes were very poor quality because they were put together at the last minute. Watery pasta, overly salty noodles, mezze platter but falafel was missing for the first hour. The service crew that came to the event was polite and helpful, but there was little they could do to salvage the situation. Super disorganised!

featured_reviews.name: jyoti seth
featured_reviews.review_text: My association with Good food concept goes back a couple of years. Whenever I’ve had a party at home, I’ve always relied on Virendra and his team. It’s always been a pleasure to deal with them, they are thoroughly professional.  The food is always fresh and delicious and the service impeccable. They go out of their way to make the occasion a memorable one. I would definitely recommend them!

featured_reviews.name: VIPUL BHATIA
featured_reviews.review_text: We recently had a party at home & got the food catered by Good Food Concept. The food was very good & the team was very professional. We were very happy overall 👍

featured_reviews.name: Jimit Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: We had them over for a small gathering of 40 people and they did not disappoint, every cuisine was delicious and our guests were really happy. Also the chef, Virender is a very friendly person to talk to and takes all your requests into consideration.

featured_reviews.name: Kanika Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: Chef Virendra and his staff did an awesome job catering my house party. Good Food Concept stepped right up and made everything beautiful and delicious. They were a pleasure to work with.

featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently entrusted this team with the decoration for our little baby boy Angad’s naming ceremony, and I must say they exceeded our expectations beautifully. We had requested for baby Hanuman theme decor.
Every guest who attended the ceremony was full of compliments and couldn't stop admiring the décor. The central floral swing and the overall pastel theme made our family photographs look absolutely stunning.
What made this even more special was the care and effort the decorators put into understanding that this wasn't just another event—it was our son Angad’s first big celebration. They added a beautiful personal touch that made the entire setup feel warm, joyful, and memorable for our family.
Thank you for helping us create such precious memories for our little Angad. Your creativity, dedication, and attention to detail truly made his naming ceremony a day we will cherish forever. I would wholeheartedly recommend your services to anyone looking for elegant and meaningful event decor.
